title: Dholavira, Gujarat: What to See Beyond the Ancient Harappan Ruins
description: Dholavira, an ancient city from the Harappan civilization, is found in Gujarat's Kutch region and is celebrated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Known for its advanced water management systems, including complex reservoirs and drainage installations, the site offers a museum that provides insights into the rich history and culture of the Harappans.
